_about: Open questions of the What/Why full pass (27 Oct 2026), plain words, for Chris Ward. Rule 131: they go at the BOTTOM of the existing What/Why question sheet (Google Doc 1QcT7FRZci6AhYcI33HUac-Oob03-gCnCOKn2NFHMLjA, questions 1-8 answered 14 Oct), numbered on from 8, in a new colour; nothing is sent by Phase A. questions.question: The developer's note of 19 Oct (SV-10130) says a Title over 255 characters now shows "Title cannot be longer than 255 characters" from the 256th character, and saving is blocked while it shows. Your page says the dialog's validation is unchanged (S1-R7) and names only "Title is a required field" (S1-R6). (a) Is "Title cannot be longer than 255 characters" the message testers should expect? (b) Did the dialog show a length message before this change (for example "Line Name cannot be longer than 255 characters"), so this is only the rename?
sources: PRD v15 S1-R6, S1-R7, Assumptions (255-character line name)
questions.note: No case written for the length message until answered (Rule 58).

questions.topic: What/Why: Invoices import row messages still use the old words
questions.question: The developer's note of 8 Oct (SV-10133) says the Invoices import's row messages keep the old wording: an empty *Line Title still says "Line name cannot be empty.", and the length message mentions "line description". Your page says the two fields are named Title and Description "everywhere a person reads them". (a) Should those import messages say "Line Title" / "Line Description" (or Title / Description) after this change? (b) Or are they out of this release, so testers should expect the old wording?
sources: PRD v15 Feature Overview, first bullet
SV-10133 comment, Nemanja Djuric, 8 Oct 2026 (Known gaps)

questions.topic: What/Why: a title that starts with =, +, - or @ in the downloaded report
questions.question: The developer's note of 8 Oct (SV-10132) says the downloaded Customer Invoice report never protected spreadsheet formulas, and now that a line no longer starts with "What are you doing?: ", a title starting with =, +, - or @ opens as a formula in Excel. Your page says values are carried as written (S3-R8, S3-R9). Is that acceptable for this release, or should testers expect such a title to open as plain text?
sources: SV-10132 comment, Nemanja Djuric, 8 Oct 2026 (Known gaps)
questions.note: No case written until answered; every Story 3 case uses titles that start with a letter.

questions.question: The design's 'Awkward inputs' board lists a line 'Imported from a previous system' among the texts that reach the books, reading "Replace tie rod - excessive play". Your page says an imported invoice never reaches the live QuickBooks sync and its text is unaffected whatever the import wrote (S3-R12). (a) Does an imported invoice appear in the downloaded Customer Invoice report? (b) If it does, should its line read "Title - Description" like any other line, as the board shows? (c) If not, what should the report show for it?

In the ShopCoach line builder, an emptied title or description cell shows "What are you doing?" / "Why are you doing it?". The developer's note on SV-10131 says the prompt shows in grey italic; your page and the design say nothing about its look. Should testers expect grey italic text there, or is the look of the empty cell not part of this change?

affects.note: the grey italic bullets quote SV-10131's developer note; if the PO says the look is not part of this change, those words come out

questions.question: On the modern invoice, the tech story prints under a "Scope of work" heading (your page, section 3). When a line has no tech story, or it reads "Tech story missing.", the page says the narrative is dropped. Is the "Scope of work" heading dropped as well, so nothing under the description is printed?
